additional_info.subject: RE: R: ID0397382-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S7 313806942001] Error causing out of service CRM:00797001597
additional_info.body:
Hi Gianluca Panegrossi,
Thank you for your response.
We have analyzed the logs for some sessions of the charger "
313806942001
". We found that there is nothing wrong with the charger, and the "Out of Service" status is brief, lasting approximately 1 to 3 second. These occurrences appeared while changing the state from B to E & E to A, which means during the process of disconnecting the vehicle from the charger. This can happen after charging, or when the customer connects the gun to the EV and removes it without starting the charging process. This is normal behavior during a state change.
Here Some Error Review for your Reference for you provided TimeStamp of the unit “
313806942001
”:
System date/time
Duration
Serial number
30/12/2024 15:30:10
313806942001
30/12/2024 15:30:09
0h 0m 1s
313806942001
For the above time, the session was ended by the user after reaching a SoC of 82%. The state changed as follows: PilotState "C2" --> “B2” --> PilotState "B2" --> "E" --> PilotState "E" --> “A”. This is normal behavior.
27/12/2024 11:02:37
27/12/2024 11:02:36
0h 0m 1s
For the above time, the session failed due to authorization being blocked by the OCPP backend. The state changed as follows: PilotState "B2" --> "E" --> PilotState "E" --> "A".
Do let us know if you need any further clarification.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team

additional_info.body:
Hi,
I’m sorry, I am not sure if I understand correctly.
I attached events from the charger with serial number 170002645 of today (2nd) at about 5 pm.
Following the events it seems that:
row 88 17:07:24 – CCS 1 is locked
row 84-86 customer asks for the authorization to charge with CCS 1 – receive OK
row 81 – 83 charger error
row 78 – 76 CCS 1 unlocked
row 74 – 75 CCS 1 locked
row 71 – 73 charger error
row 68 -  70 CCS 1 unlocked
row 64 – 67 CCS 1 locked and than unlocked
row 61-63 customer asks for the authorization to charge with CCS 2– receive OK
row 56 – 60 CCS 2 is unlocked and it waits for 90 seconds to be connected – after this time session it is closed
row 53-56 customer asks for the authorization to charge with CCS 1– receive OK – 17:18
row 52 - …… CCS 1 locked, power delivery OK .. start charging
Conclusion: it seems that in the sequence of activities to activate charging is that the customer must first ask for authorization and then insert the cable. If the client inserts the cable first and then asks for authorization, the charger goes into error
is this behavior correct? is it not possible to activate a recharge by first plugging in the cable and then asking for permission?
Best regards
Gianluca

additional_info.body:
Hi Gianluca,
I hope you're doing well.
Regarding your query, yes, it is possible to initiate the charging in both ways. You can either connect the EV to the charger and then authorize, or vice versa. Please find the attached screenshots of charger
Y2 / S7 313806942001
.
For your reference. In the first snapshot, the EV is connected before authentication, and after successful authorization, the charging session is completed without any issues.
In the second snapshot, after authentication, the EV is then connected, and the charging session is successfully initiated.
In previous email it is explained that the charging session failures were due to the RFID block command from OCPP, which caused the interruptions.
As for charger
MP / R9 170002645
you mentioned, the charging sessions were failing due to a payment terminal error. I can confirm that the charger is now healthy and operating correctly.
Please try initiating a charging session again. If the issue persists, kindly create a new ticket, and we’ll investigate further.
We are proceeding with case closure as your queries have been addressed and the charging for charger
Y2 / S7 313806942001
is running smoothly without errors.
Should you have any further questions or need additional support, please don’t hesitate to reach out.
Best Regards,
Ankita
eMobility Support Team
